title: Exactness in length one for a matrix presentation
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a criterion for exactness in length one of a complex built from a matrix, phrased through the invertibility of a maximal minor, and the proof is a 54-line argument. It treats the case of an invertible maximal minor by an explicit change of bases that diagonalises the matrix and then reads the kernel off the diagonal form, and it reduces the general case to that one by localising at the primes where the relevant minors become units. Both the basis change and the exactness verification after it are displayed.
